title: GET /api/v1/users/:username/stats with total_seconds=true, 200
description: The early returns in StatsController#user_stats, stats_controller.rb line 66 (test_param=true) and line 90 (otherwise): only the total, with no data object and no trust_factor. This is how Stardance reads the hours for the Hackatime projects linked to one of its projects, and it rejects anything but a non-negative integer here (stardance hackatime_service.rb lines 147-152).
